name: Rainy Morning Indie
description: Warm, intimate indie folk-pop for slow rainy mornings: soft fingerpicked acoustic guitar, close-miked vocals, gentle brushed drums and a hint of tape warmth.
vocal_style: soft, breathy close-miked lead vocal with light harmonies in the chorus
lyric_themes: rain on the window and a slow morning
production: organic, lo-fi warmth, gentle tape saturation, roomy but intimate mix
